Shanice: I hope you don’t mind that I started skating already.

Bot: You were great out there! How did you learn it?
#Nun_NewOutfit.Eyes.Really+Nun_NewOutfit.Mouth.Normal
Shanice: He~ I see you two finally started noticing my greatness!
#Nun_NewOutfit.Face.nunFaceNormal
Shanice: I was pretty good at skating at college, but doing all this training and stress from the competitions burned me out.
Shanice: It’s nice coming back to it from time to time and goofing around with friends, but I don’t miss competing with others.
Shanice: What are you two waiting for! Get your skates and let’s go!
